top_signals.title: Stocks, Futures Rise on Nvidia Outlook; Oil Falls: Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: Nvidia Corp.’s bullish sales outlook boosted stocks and futures, bolstering optimism that this year’s rally in artificial intelligence shares has further to run. Oil fell for a fourth day.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
